parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for keyset pagination. To retrieve the next page of results, pass the `nextToken` value from the previous response. Omit this parameter to retrieve the first page.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The property to sort the results by. Default: `gmtCreate`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve. This parameter is used for page number-based pagination and is ignored if `pagination` is set to `keyset`.

parameters.name: pagination
parameters.description: The pagination mode. Set this to `keyset` to use keyset pagination.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: The number of items to return per page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 100. Default: 20.

parameters.name: releaseStageSn
parameters.description: The serial number (SN) of the release stage.

parameters.name: releaseWorkflowSn
parameters.description: The serial number (SN) of the release workflow.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort order. Use `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order. Default: `desc`.
